zh.title: 空中巴士與波音2026年交機量均超越去年同期
zh.summary: 空中巴士與波音交機雙雙增長；星宇航空於八月獲交付A330neo。
body: 根據民航媒體 AeroTime 報導，2026 年空中巴士與波音的客機交付表現均超越去年同期。截至目前，空中巴士在 2026 年已交付 475 架飛機（去年同期為 434 架），而波音則交付了 418 架飛機（去年同期為 385 架）。兩家製造商儘管面臨供應鏈與品質控管挑戰，整體的交付量仍有所提升。
在個別機型方面，星宇航空於 2026 年 8 月 10 日接收了一架空中巴士 A330neo 客機。在此之前，由於水平尾翼的檢查工作，空中巴士在 6 月和 7 月並未交付任何該型客機。另一方面，波音 787 夢幻客機在 8 月的交付量出現下滑，僅交付 4 架，低於 7 月的 10 架與 6 月的 13 架。

en.title: Airbus and Boeing Outpace 2025 Delivery Totals Despite Production Challenges
en.summary: Airbus and Boeing outpaced their 2025 delivery totals; STARLUX Airlines received an A330neo in August.
body: According to aviation news portal AeroTime, both Airbus and Boeing are outpacing their 2025 delivery performances. So far in 2026, Airbus has delivered 475 aircraft compared to 434 at the same point last year, while Boeing has delivered 418 aircraft compared to 385 in 2025. Both manufacturers achieved these increases despite facing ongoing engine shortages and quality concerns.

Among notable deliveries, STARLUX Airlines received an Airbus A330neo on August 10, 2026, marking a resumption after inspections of the horizontal tail plane halted deliveries in June and July. Meanwhile, Boeing experienced a drop in 787 Dreamliner deliveries, handing over only four aircraft in August 2026, compared to 10 in July and 13 in June.

zh.title: 漢莎航空鯊魚皮薄膜接近取得空中巴士A330認證
zh.summary: 漢莎航空技術首度應用於空中巴士寬體客機；鯊魚皮薄膜認證進入尾聲。
body: 根據航空媒體 Simple Flying 報導，漢莎航空（Lufthansa）研發的鯊魚皮表面薄膜技術，目前已接近取得空中巴士（Airbus）A330型客機的官方認證。根據報導，這也是此項創新技術首度被實際部署與應用在空中巴士的寬體客機上。
作為背景，空中巴士的 A330 系列客機在 2026 年夏季曾因技術檢查而導致交付受阻。根據歷史紀錄，當時因在交付前檢查中於 A330neo 結構內發現工具，引發對水平尾翼的疑慮，導致交付一度中斷。空中巴士隨後確認該問題屬於孤立事件並已找出根本原因，且已恢復該機型的交付。

en.title: Lufthansa Shark-Skin Surface Film Nears Airbus A330 Certification
en.summary: Lufthansa's shark-skin surface film is nearing Airbus A330 certification, marking its first widebody deployment.
body: According to a report by aviation media Simple Flying, Lufthansa's innovative shark-skin surface film is nearing certification for the Airbus A330 aircraft. This development represents the first time that this technology has been deployed on an Airbus widebody airliner.

In background developments, Airbus A330 deliveries had previously faced disruptions. According to verified historical records, Airbus A330neo deliveries were severely hampered during the summer of 2026 due to concerns regarding the horizontal tail plane, initiated after a tool was discovered inside an aircraft's structure. Airbus subsequently identified the root cause as an isolated issue and successfully resumed A330 deliveries.
